name: Hive 1.5.7
notes: In a local (relay-less) workspace, Hive now auto-responds to an unaddressed message again — you no longer have to @hive every time. Same root cause as 1.5.6: identity churn leaves an old 'you' in the hoisted roster under a stale account id, which inflated the human count so an unaddressed 'hi' looked like a multi-human room and stayed silent. With no relay, every roster member was necessarily created on this device and is you, so the workspace is treated as solo. Explicit @hive already worked; this restores the no-mention default.
